report.explanation: Current gateway telemetry is healthy: traces OK, error_rate 0.0014, p95 72ms, no dependency timeouts or pool waiters, INFO/200 logs. This contradicts the alert and does not establish any bounded root cause. Downstream services in the topology have no observations, so the fault cannot be localized. Handing off for downstream and alert-window evidence.
missing_evidence: Current telemetry for order, inventory, payment, postgresql, and redis services (metrics, traces, logs) to locate the error/latency source
Error-rate and latency time series covering the alert window to confirm the alert is active
Per-service error breakdown (HTTP 5xx, timeouts) to distinguish http-500, db-pool-exhaustion, redis-timeout, downstream-latency
Configuration change records for the alert window to assess bad-configuration
Memory-retention time series per service to assess memory-leak
